prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
On August 16, 2026, at Mazda Stadium, the Hanshin Tigers turned a fast start into an 8-1 win over the Hiroshima Carp.

The first blow came in the first inning. Teruaki Sato sent a two-run home run to center field, giving Hanshin a 2-0 lead.

The key question was whether Hanshin could protect that early lead. Starting pitcher Ryoto Ihara gave a strong answer. He pitched five innings, allowing only two hits and one run.

Hiroshima’s only run came in the fifth inning, when Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run.

Hanshin kept attacking. The Tigers added more runs in the seventh and eighth innings, and the game moved further away from a close finish.

By the end, the pattern was clear. Hanshin struck first, received steady pitching from Ihara, and kept adding to the score. Hiroshima had one powerful moment, but no wider comeback followed. The result was an 8-1 Hanshin victory.

【Point One】
Sato’s shot was more than an early two-run homer. It was his 28th home run, hit on the third pitch, a two-seam pitch after one ball and one strike. It left him one home run behind teammate Shota Morishita, who had 29. The opening swing also created a small team home-run race.

【Point Two】
Hiroshima’s scoring was isolated: Montero’s solo homer was its only run. Hanshin’s later scoring had a different shape. In the seventh and eighth innings, Seishiro Sakamoto and pinch-hitter Fushimi delivered key hits. The result was not decided by one home run alone. Hanshin kept applying pressure, while Hiroshima had no second scoring burst.
